## CELL FACTS

Cell 金_火. Core element Metal, energy element Fire. Law: Fire tames Metal (火克金: the forge softens the blade). Relative to the core the energy is the tamer, so Fire is this core's Order.
- Family personas and ruled domains (the cost domain: the cost is named in these words or in ordinary life, work only where a domain word is work; the definition names one drive per persona, E8): The General: Pressure, Command, Crisis · The Magistrate: Career, Status, Order
- mechanism.classic (the sourced epigraph): "精勝堅，故火勝金"

- mechanism.friction_turn: "Run heavy, the forge never closes: constant heat, no bench time, a blade softening under pressure it never leaves. Step out of the fire long enough to hold an edge."
- function.definition_catalyst: [REDACTED: the target field]
- function.definition_friction: "Fire is your Order, and as a friction, it is order with the thermostat broken. Every rule runs hot, every moment gets treated like an emergency, and the structure that held things up presses down on people, then hardest on you. Nobody judges the edge as harshly as you do."
- function.advise_catalyst: [REDACTED: the target field]
- function.advise_friction: "Command works best rationed. Before taking over, ask one question and wait for the whole answer. Rank the week’s fires and let the bottom three burn out alone. Schedule the rest before the crash schedules it for you. Order people can breathe in is the only kind that holds."

The eight wide openers (a carry.wide clause opens with one; no core repeats one across its wanted energies): "{Element} is one thing you never run short of" · "{Element} is easy for you to reach" · "{Element} is all around you" · "You have plenty of {Element}" · "{Element} is already here in plenty" · "You are well supplied with {Element}" · "You were given plenty of {Element}" · "There is no shortage of {Element} in you".
Fields shown above that are not the target are context for the repetition law (no four-word run shared with them) and for the cut law; do not rewrite them.

## CELL FACTS

Cell 火_七杀 (Fire carrying The General). Persona The General (七杀). Definition line: "Pressure that doesn't grant permission, the trial that forges". Keyword Force, charge fierce, poles catalyst Command / friction Harshness. Family function: Order. Cost dimension: pressure that does not ask permission; peace can feel like demotion. Arena: forge, campaign, the weight of command, tempering. Classical portrait: pressure as clarity; the trial that forges; force without permission; peace felt as demotion. Ruled domains: Pressure, Command, Crisis. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 正官.
Element arena: Fire (flame, light, warmth, fuel, the hearth, the blaze). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Metal. structural_interaction seed: "Fire pressing Metal same-polarity — the forge that doesn't moderate itself".
- k2_overview: "Your Fire moves as the General: heat weaponized into will. You command like a charge, blazing conviction that armies of ordinary people find themselves following. Crisis makes you luminous. Peacetime makes you dangerous to furniture. Aim the cannon, always. Unaimed, this much fire tests every relationship it warms."
- k2_functional: "Your order is fire discipline: absolute at the front, enforced on yourself before anyone else feels it."
- adj_chips: {"friction":["Too intense","Bossy","Burned-out"],"catalyst":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Pressure":"Pressure ignites you: stakes convert your heat into focus. Without real battles you invent them, so keep a worthy campaign running at all times, professional or physical.","Command":"You command by fire: vision hot enough to melt objections. Troops follow the light. Mind the scorch radius, and let cooler officers handle the discipline your heat would burn.","Crisis":"Crisis is your parade ground: you charge while others count. Victory loves you. Afterward, check who got trampled in the charge, including you."}

mechanism.base.value: Steel is only steel because something burned it first. In the forge the metal goes soft and, for a while, obedient, and the hammer gives it the shape it will keep for a hundred years. Take the fire away and the ore stays ore, hard in the wrong places and useless for anything fine. The saying is that fire overcomes metal. It is truer to say fire finishes it.
mechanism.base._trace: Fire tames Metal, the forge softens the blade: heat as the thing that gives steel its finished shape

mechanism.catalyst_turn.value: With too little Fire, the steel goes unworked: an edge sure of its shape, with nothing to test it. Take on one thing this year that could fail in public.

function.definition_catalyst.value: Fire is your Order, and as a catalyst, it is heat the edge answers to. Crisis pulls at you and makes you clearest when everything is on fire, at the cost of quiet weeks you cannot sit through, while the wish for a place keeps you inside the rules and costs you the step outside.

text.law: One row, one tension, three angles (owner 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-01). Every passage: a flat claim about the reader, the mechanism stated flat from the chart's supply, the either-or in the reader's second person, the cost from this angle. No passage opens on a picture, a moment or other people; a picture is permitted where it sharpens the tension and never required; no clock time, no place, no narration, no claimed memory (a time or place stamp is blocked by the gate); no aphorism close by default. The gate notes a passage with no tension sentence (two clauses in the second person joined by or, but, yet, while, or whether … or not) and a first sentence carrying an object noun outside this persona's domain words; the read decides.

value.text: You take charge the moment nobody else does, and sometimes a moment before. Your chart carries little Fire, and what heat there is gets spent at the front. You step in because it needs doing, or because waiting feels like a demotion. Permission is what this costs you.

value_b.text: Command comes to you without a title, and you use it before anyone hands it over. Fire is short in you, and the little there is burns where the decision is. You lead because the gap is open, or because standing behind someone feels like defeat. The price is being rarely asked.

value.text: You push people the way you push yourself. Fire is a small supply in you, so what heat you have gets aimed at whoever is closest to the job. You set the pace because it must get done, or because slowing would hand it to someone else. The people under it give up their own.

function.advise_catalyst.value: An edge nobody has tested is a guess about yourself. Enter one thing a year with a judge in it, a race, an exam, a review by someone senior. Take the deadline you are not sure you can make. Let one person tell you, to your face, what you got wrong this month.

cta_verdict.value: Pressure is what puts you in order, so the worst version of you usually shows up when nothing is being asked of you.
cta_verdict.value_b: Rules only hold you when there is heat in them, which is why a deadline does for you what a plan never quite manages.
